correctness.rationale: Exact diagonal form follows from normalized circle probability and Bergman e_n=sqrt(n+1)z^n; no density of the measure is assumed. Substituting j=floor(log_b n)+ell and bounding the two bilateral tails uniformly yields periodic profile. Fourier exchange and Mellin substitution give Gamma(alpha-2pi im/log b)/log b; zero-free Gamma gives nonconstancy. Uniform positive bounds yield compactness and precise Schatten exponent. For critical A=T^p_c, a_n=(H(log_b n)+o(1))/n; compare sum of first N entries to integral dx H(log_b x)/x and show its logarithmic average tends mean H. Rearranged N largest terms lie among first BN by two-sided c/n,C/n; sums between N and BN differ O(1), proving ordinary Dixmier-logarithmic limit. Independent fresh finite eigenvalue/profile calculations for 3 (alpha,b) pairs, phase samples and alpha=2 numerical quadrature at b=2,4 passed; numerical checks do not prove asymptotics.

value.rationale: A singular radial Bergman measure with exactly computable nonconstant log-periodic eigenvalue constants but a UNIQUE Dixmier trace at the critical power supplies a concrete, motivated operator-theoretic contrast between pointwise spectral oscillation and logarithmic trace averaging. Explicit Gamma Fourier modes and critical trace are independently useful invariant data, not a generic diagonalization restatement.

final_claim: For all alpha>1,b>1 the geometric-circle Bergman Toeplitz T has monomial eigenvalues lambda_n=(n+1)sum_j b^{-alpha j}(1-b^{-j})^n, with uniform profile n^(alpha-1)lambda_n=G(log_b n)+o(1), Gamma Fourier coefficients, nondegenerate cluster interval, S_p iff p>1/(alpha-1), and T^p_c Dixmier measurable with trace integral_0^1 G^p_c. In alpha=2 trace T=1/log b.
limitations: Only explicit geometric-circle family with alpha>1,b>1.
Does not assert a pointwise asymptotic of decreasing rearrangement or general nonradial Toeplitz operators.
Schatten threshold alone is not credited as new.
